references.title: Treewidth of the n x n Toroidal Grid
references.note: Proves that the n by n toroidal grid has treewidth exactly 2n-1 for all n at least five.

references.title: The Treewidth of Line Graphs
references.source: Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series B; arXiv:1409.6810
references.note: Includes the elementary transfer tw(L(G)) >= (tw(G)+1)/2 - 1 used to obtain linear primal treewidth for toroidal Tseitin CNFs.

references.title: Tight Bounds for Tseitin Formulas
references.note: Uses the standard edge-variable Tseitin encoding and records treewidth-sensitive lower-bound behavior; C018 uses only the elementary component-charge satisfiability criterion and explicit CNF construction.

claim_boundary: The references certify external theorems used in C018. They do not prove the new JANUS local-twin or factorization claims by themselves.
